title: Baseline 7-Model Training & Evaluation
objective: Train and evaluate 7 baseline algorithms (LR, DT, RF, SVM, XGB, LGBM, CAT) on 2015 BRFSS data
key_outcome: SVM highest raw accuracy (80.14%) via majority voting; tree models (XGB, LGBM, CAT) balanced

title: Optuna Hyperparameter Optimization
objective: 20-trial TPE Bayesian search for XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost optimizing 5-fold CV Macro-F1
key_outcome: XGBoost best trial 0 (0.4384 Macro-F1); LightGBM best trial 2 (0.4283 Macro-F1)

title: Out-of-Fold Probability & Meta-Feature Extraction
objective: Generate out-of-fold predictions on training folds and evaluate test predictions
dataset_split: 5-Fold Stratified CV on Train + Post-Hoc Test Evaluation
feature_count: 50 Meta-Features (21 Probs, 7 Conf, 7 Entropy, 7 Margin, 7 Disagree, 1 Agree)
key_outcome: Zero data leakage confirmed; 202,944 OOF rows and 50,736 test rows generated

title: Meta-Learner Architecture and Multi-Stage Ablation (M1 to M4)
objective: Progressive ablation of meta-features: Base Probs -> Conf -> Uncertainty -> Consensus
dataset_split: Trained on OOF Meta-Matrix, Evaluated on Locked Test Set
key_outcome: Uncertainty metrics provide +2.7% accuracy boost in unweighted setting; consensus disambiguates discordance

title: Class-Weight Balancing and Stacking vs Hybrid Rectification
objective: Standardize inverse-frequency class weighting across Standard Stacking and Failure-Aware Hybrid
key_outcome: Hybrid achieves 61.01% accuracy (+1.01% over Stacking, p<0.001) while eliminating 973 false alarms

title: Statistical Significance & Bootstrap Verification
objective: 2,000 paired bootstrap resamples and McNemar discordance test
key_outcome: Accuracy advantage significant (p<0.001); Macro-F1 parity confirmed (p=0.224); McNemar chi2=123.21 (p=1.25e-28)

title: Duplicate Profile & Generalizability Validation
objective: Evaluate model robustness across 43,813 unique test profiles vs 6,923 overlapping survey profiles
key_outcome: Zero shortcut memorization; hybrid accuracy advantage maintained across both cohorts (+0.93% and +1.44%)

title: Explainable AI (SHAP & LIME)
objective: Global multi-class attribution via TreeExplainer and local case auditing via LIME
key_outcome: Engineered interactions (BMI_Age_Interaction, GenHlth_BMI) top contributors; false negative audited
